Despite claiming it would focus on land acquisition and development, Millrose allegedly purchased approximately $200 million in finished homes from Lennar and rented them at a loss. Following a Hunterbrook Media report on October 2, 2026, MRP's stock fell 8.5% to $22.51. Investors who purchased MRP securities between February 7, 2025 and October 2, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses.

BAC.title: JPM Q3 Earnings Lag on Lower Fixed Income Markets, IB Offer Support
BAC.summary: JPMorgan Chase reported Q3 2026 adjusted earnings of $5.75 per share, missing consensus estimates of $5.94, though revenues rose 8% to $50.17 billion. The bank benefited from strong equity trading (up 15%), investment banking (up 15%), and net interest income growth (up 13%), but faced headwinds from weak fixed income trading and rising expenses. Management raised its 2026 NII outlook to $106.2 billion but also increased expense guidance to $108.6 billion.

BAC.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
BAC.summary: Goldman Sachs reported Q3 2026 earnings of $17.01 per share, significantly beating consensus estimates of $12.90 and delivering a 31.86% earnings surprise. Revenue also exceeded expectations at $18.68 billion. However, the stock has underperformed the S&P 500 year-to-date, gaining only 1.7% versus the market's 14.1%. Goldman received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with mixed estimate revisions. Bank of America is expected to report results on October 14 with projected earnings of $1.11 per share.

CORT.title: PMVP Stock Rises 19% in 3 Months: Here's What You Need to Know
CORT.summary: PMV Pharmaceuticals (PMVP) has gained nearly 19% in three months following encouraging clinical data for its lead drug rezatapopt, which achieved a 46% response rate in ovarian cancer patients. The company plans to submit an NDA in Q1 2027 and raised $50.8 million through a public offering to fund operations into Q1 2028.

CTNM.title: BMY Reports Mixed Phase III Trial Results, Stock Down
CTNM.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb announced mixed Phase III results for admilparant in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, meeting its primary endpoint only at the 60-mg dose while failing at 120-mg, causing the stock to decline 2.6%. However, the company reported positive Phase III results for RYZ101 in advanced gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, demonstrating statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival. The mixed outcomes reflect uncertainty about admilparant's dose consistency despite favorable safety profiles.

CTNM.title: All You Need to Know About Contineum Therapeutics, Inc. (CTNM) Rating Upgrade to Buy
CTNM.summary: Contineum Therapeutics, Inc. (CTNM) has been upgraded to a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating based on upward trends in earnings estimates. SOAR.title: Volato Surges 85% in Three Months: Should You Buy the Stock?
SOAR.summary: Volato Group (SOAR) shares have surged 84.6% over three months, driven by its September 2026 merger with Alignment Engine and substantial AI infrastructure contracts worth $1.2 billion. The company's Ohio campus offers 154 MW of power expandable to 480 MW, supporting AI training and computing operations. GS.title: Goldman Q3 Earnings Beat on Strong Equities & IB Revenues, Shares Rise
GS.summary: Goldman Sachs reported strong Q3 2026 earnings with EPS of $17.01, beating estimates by 31.9% and jumping 39% year-over-year. Net revenues rose 23% to $18.68B, driven by a 72% surge in Equities revenues to $6.44B and 21% increase in investment banking fees to $3.22B. APP.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AppLovin Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
APP.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims that between February 12, 2026 and August 5, 2026, the company made false or misleading statements regarding its generative AI video creative feature, overstating AI model improvements and the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition. Investors who purchased AppLovin securities during this period are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 16, 2026.

APP.title: AppLovin (APP) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know
APP.summary: AppLovin stock declined 2.28% on October 12, 2026, underperforming the broader market. The mobile app technology company has dropped 14.48% over the past month, significantly lagging the S&P 500's 2.36% gain. Despite strong earnings growth forecasts (61.22% EPS growth expected), AppLovin holds a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating and trades at a premium valuation with a Forward P/E of 17.62 versus its industry average of 15.88.

CNK.title: AMC Stock Gains 20% in a Month: Should Investors Ride the Rally?
CNK.summary: AMC Entertainment shares surged 20% in the past month, outperforming the leisure industry, driven by stronger moviegoing demand, higher per-patron spending, and effective cost controls. The company plans to add 150-250 premium auditoriums using third-party capital, expand its loyalty programs with over 40 million participants, and expects $100 million in movie-themed merchandise revenue in 2026. Refinancing efforts and anticipated interest savings of approximately $67 million annually are expected to improve cash flow breakeven. AMC trades at a discounted forward sales multiple of 0.47 compared to the industry average of 2.62, earning a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating.

CNK.title: Cinemark's Digital Marketing Push: Can It Strengthen Customer Loyalty?
CNK.summary: Cinemark is expanding its digital marketing and personalization efforts to attract younger moviegoers and boost customer loyalty, leveraging its 40 million addressable customers for targeted promotions and social media campaigns. The company's stock has surged 45.1% over the past year, trading at a forward P/S multiple of 1.15 below industry average, with 2026 EPS estimates rising 141.4% year-over-year. However, sustained success depends on campaign resonance and film slate appeal.

The company invested €114.8 million at an average price of €344.08 per share on Euronext Milan. Since January 2026, Ferrari has purchased 2,032,307 shares for a total consideration of €627.7 million under its multi-year €3.5 billion buyback initiative expected to conclude by 2030.

RIG.title: Transocean Adds $1.1B to Backlog With Shell and Equinor Deals
RIG.summary: Transocean Ltd. has secured approximately $1.1 billion in new firm backlog additions through contracts with Shell and Equinor. Shell's two-well contract with its Norwegian subsidiary adds $62 million for the Transocean Norge rig, while Equinor's final approval converts $1 billion into firm backlog for three harsh-environment semisubmersible rigs operating offshore Norway. These agreements strengthen Transocean's contracted drilling activity and visibility in the Norwegian Continental Shelf.

AXIL.title: AXIL Brands' Product Launch & Strong Liquidity: Buy or Hold?
AXIL.summary: AXIL Brands has outperformed its sub-industry despite a challenging first quarter with 11.2% revenue decline. The newly launched XCOR II earbuds show promise with $3.6 million in initial orders, while improved liquidity ($7.9 million cash, no debt) and a discounted valuation (9.54X EV/EBITDA) provide support. However, analysts recommend holding rather than buying, citing the need for sustained demand demonstration and recurring cash generation before confirming a durable recovery.
